code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, and increased monocytes, basophils, ferritin, LDH, and alkaline phosphatase. There is also low total protein and mild hypoglycemia. These findings suggest a possible underlying inflammatory or infectious process, with evidence of bone marrow involvement or stress. Further clinical correlation and additional investigations are recommended to clarify the etiology.
